Istanbul. We have a revolutionary facility located in the heart of Istanbul Industrial Zone,
equipped with the latest technology and managed by a team of experienced professionals.

gloss, matte, primer, color and more coatings, as well as custom solutions to meet the specific
needs of our customers. Whether you want to protect printed materials, plastics or metals and
enhance their appearance, our coatings provide long-lasting protection and improve the overall
appearance of your products.

Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction is evident in every aspect of our business. We
use only the highest grade materials and implement strict quality control measures to meet the
highest standards of performance and durability.

If you need UV Paint, Varnish, Ink services wherever you are, look no further than Atlas UV
Coatings. Contact us today to learn more about our products and services and request a quote. We
look forward to working with you!

## Who we are

POR-15^{®} high-performance coatings revolutionized rust protection in 1978 with our unrivaled
moisture cure rust preventive undercoating technology. Our state-of-the-art paint systems form an
impenetrable barrier that protects surfaces from water, chemicals, salt, U.V. rays, corrosive
contaminants, impacts, and everyday wear and tear. Designed for application directly on rusted or
seasoned metal surfaces and concrete; POR-15^{®} products are applied to vehicles, heavy-duty
equipment, and structures around the world. Our products are used on antique cars in museums, DIY
classic cars, professional award-winning automotive restorations, body shops, government trucks, and
heavy-duty farm equipment. We are the gold standard in rust prevention, and we will continue
focusing on the quality and performance of our POR-15^{®} branded products and elevating them to a
new level.

# About us

lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,

## More than 150 years of experience in the coatings industry



## **Refinish and Aftermarket**

Experience the difference with our industry-leading refinish products ranging from surface
preparation to undercoats, basecoats, clearcoats, color-matching technologies and accessories. As
the leader in the refinish market we are supporting body shops around the world and reshaping the
industry through innovation for a better way of doing business.

[Learn about our Refinish products][6]



## **Mobility**

We are leading the way in light vehicle and commercial vehicle coatings for original equipment
manufacturers through advanced technologies that protect vehicle exteriors and interiors, insulate
electric motors, increase productivity in the paint shop, and add beauty and color. Our Mobility
solutions comprise Axalta's best-in-class basecoats and clearcoats for color and beautification
along with primers, electrocoats and powder applications for surface protection.

[Learn about our Mobility coatings][7]



## **Industrial**

Our performance coatings are ideal for a wide variety of industrial applications. Our liquid,
electrocoat and powder coating solutions serve an array of industrial segments including those
manufacturing industrial and electrical system components, oil and gas pipelines, wood applications,
agricultural, construction and earth moving equipment, rail cars, structural steel, and sports
equipment.

## More than 150 years of experience in the coatings industry



## **Refinish and Aftermarket**

Experience the difference with our industry-leading refinish products ranging from surface
preparation to undercoats, basecoats, clearcoats, color-matching technologies and accessories. As
the leader in the refinish market we are supporting body shops around the world and reshaping the
industry through innovation for a better way of doing business.

[Learn about our Refinish products][6]



## **Mobility**

We are leading the way in light vehicle and commercial vehicle coatings for original equipment
manufacturers through advanced technologies that protect vehicle exteriors and interiors, insulate
electric motors, increase productivity in the paint shop, and add beauty and color. Our Mobility
solutions comprise Axalta's best-in-class basecoats and clearcoats for color and beautification
along with primers, electrocoats and powder applications for surface protection.

[Learn about our Mobility coatings][7]



## **Industrial**

Our performance coatings are ideal for a wide variety of industrial applications. Our liquid,
electrocoat and powder coating solutions serve an array of industrial segments including those
manufacturing industrial and electrical system components, oil and gas pipelines, wood applications,
agricultural, construction and earth moving equipment, rail cars, structural steel, and sports
equipment.

## Aerospace

### Engineered for Performance

Delivering new technologies for transparencies, coatings, sealants, packaging, and chemical
management for the aviation industries.

Learn More

## Automotive OEM

### Forefront of Innovation

Combining PPG’s expertise in coatings and technologies to aid automakers around the world in
enhancing the image and identity of their vehicle brands.

Learn More

## Automotive Refinish

### Breakthrough Performance

When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, PPG's refinish
business owns a track record of success no other company can match.

Learn More

## Industrial Coatings

### Tomorrow Realized

Leading manufacturers trust PPG’s global color stylists, chemists and technical application experts
to provide the innovative coatings that enhance the products we use every day.

Learn More

## Packaging Coatings

### Leading the Pack

For decades, PPG’s research and development experts have created coatings that have made products
better across nearly every industry, from food and beverage, to cosmetics and personal care, to
paints and chemicals. 

Learn More

## Protective & Marine Coatings

### Unrivaled Performance

Developing products that protect customers’ assets in some of the world’s most demanding conditions
and environments, including civil infrastructure, offshore, petrochemical, power, marine new-build,
marine dry dock and marine sea stock.

Learn More

## Traffic Solutions

### Performance that protects

The broad, global portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint,
thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road
workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

Learn More

An innovative new technology that make the sustainable recovery of industrial process water and

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

## PREFERRED SUPPLIER

Boero YachtCoatings are the preferred choice, as we ensure our customers have the best custom
coating solutions, from the full and versatile range of product, superior performance for any type
of substrate, application and conditions, all supported by the Boero technical team and product
warranty

### Boero LifeCycle

An integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and services to meet the most
complex requirements.

We promote the Boero LifeCycle with a dedicated team, focused on the best maintenance and aftersales
service to superyacht: shipyards, captains and management, offering global support, product
information and service. We support the Boero LifeCycle with our technical services, offering
practical coatings advice, specification, inspection and various levels of training.

[Discover Boero LifeCycle][41]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Boero Technical Service

Boero YachtCoatings actively engages in customer service by taking our involvement with our
customers past the point of the actual sale of our products into the shipyard, dry dock,
construction site and workshops to assist our customers obtain the required coating finish and to
conform to the project coating specification.
Boero YachtCoatings achieves this in field service by employing a dedicated group of qualified
staff, known as Boero Coating Advisors. Boero Coating Advisors are located in most of the markets
where Boero YachtCoatings is promoting and selling products, being part of the local technical
service team and report to the local Technical Service Manager.

[Discover Techical Services][42]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Full range of products

Boero YachtCoatings has a comprehensive range of products and coating solutions that cover all
requirements for both yacht and superyacht painting. Coatings that cover above and below waterline,
exterior and interior systems and all types of tanks and specialist areas.
With a variety of product options in each product group: Anti-fouling, Fillers, Primers, Tank
coatings and Topcoats – Boero YachtCoatings has a coating solution to suit all needs, offering
performance in the most demanding of environments.
Boero YachtCoatings offer complete coating systems to suit a variety of uses, application,
environmental conditions and expected finish.

[Discover Products][43]

# **Welcome to Clean Coats**

### About Us

**[Clean Coats Company Image]CLEAN COATS has been a leader in the field of Specialty Coatings in
India for over 2 decades. We provide state-of-the-art coatings for a wide range of applications.
including Wall & Floor Coatings, Tank, structural, pipeline,concrete coatings. Our coatings are
backed by extensive research and development, and are trusted by customers across the country.
**

With an in-house team of experienced professionals, we execute coating projects of all sizes with
complete responsibility for selected high-value projects in the corporate sector.

**Reliable performance. Customized Solutions. Large Project Capabilities. Wide Range**

Clean Coats has a very strong presence in Irrigation, Water Supply, Power, Oil-Gas & Refinery,
Chemical, Pharma, Food, Automobile & many other such industries. We also export to over 27 countries
and have satisfied customers all over the world.

The Organization has qualified professionals with significant experience in various areas such as
Research & Development, Technical Support, Quality Control, Specification design and Site Execution.

CLEAN COATS has a consistent and well established track record of servicing its Clients. It has an
in-house application team as well in order to provide Clients with a comprehensive and
end-to-end-service package.

**The Company is accredited with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications.**

## Our Product Offerings

[

#### FOOD GRADE PIPE INTERNAL COATING

][15]

CLEAN TECH PW -food grade epoxy coating with over 25 lac m2 of successful performance; certified by
CFTRI,WRAS & conforming to AWWA C210 & IS16676 for potable water services

[

#### PIPE INTERNAL
#### COATING

][16]

We offer our glass flake, phenolic epoxy coatings to combat pipe internal corrosion against a
variety of service media like effluent water, sea water, RO Water, DM Water etc., Chemicals &
hydrocarbbons like ATF, natural gas etc..

[

#### SOLAR PANEL STRUCTURE COATING

][17]

Our R&D customized a corrosion protection solution for application on solar trackers & structures in
C5M environment like the photo of a large project at Morrocco done under French consultant

[

#### SWEATING & CRYOGENIC LINE PROTECTION

][18]
Our uniquely formulated product CHEMITECH UW enables coating of cryogenic & ice encrusted pipelines
in insitu running condition like this at a fertilizer major at Mumbai.

[

#### PIPE EXTERNAL
#### COATING

][19]

We offer multiple solutions like High solids polyurethane, High solids epoxy conforming to DIN
10289, traditional corrosion resistant coating systems. The photo is from a sea water based gas
based power plant in Gujarat

[

#### MOUNDED STORAGE VESSELS COATINGS

][20]

Our solvent free polyurethane coating CLEAN TECH HPEC 1001(J) has been successfully performing in a
number of mounded bullets of almost all oil majors like BPCL,IOCL etc. Above Job done for LPG
terminal at Nagpur.

[

#### CLEAN ROOM WALL COATING

][21]
We offer unmatched clean room wall & floor coatings for pharma industries & operation theatres in
hospitals. The photo is the image of the job done at Breach Candy Hospital Mumbai.

[

#### METAL REPAIR
#### PRODUCTS

][22]
The power of ceramic reinforced epoxies has been harnessed in our Metal Repair Products to enable
faster restoration of worn out metals & improve fluid flow conditions

[

#### ANTI - CARBONATION
#### COATING

][23]
our Anti Carbonation Coating successfully protect number of structures like the Shivaji Memorial in
Mumbai.


[

#### HEAT RESISTANT
#### COATING

][24]
Heat resistant coatings that can resist upto 600 deg centigrade. Photo is of chimney coating from a
coastal gas based power plant at Maharashtra


[

#### BI-POLAR CONCRETE ADMIXTURE

][25]
Our CONPROOF IA is a powerful bi polar Concrete penetrating corrosion inhibiting admixture that is
approved by EIL & has been used in a number of oil & gas projects across the country.

[

#### EPOXY & PU FLOORING

][26]
Our pioneering product line consisting of high performing Epoxy & PU flooring systems for over 20
years for food & pharma, auto & a variety of other industries & warehouses. The range also has car
park coatings.


#### Solutions

The Company is accredited with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications.

We proudly carry thousands of products from the leaders in our industry like AkzoNobel Aerospace,

#### Express shipping

90% of our orders ship out the same or next day, with no expediting fees. At Creative Coatings,
getting your orders out the door same or next day is the expectation - not the exception.

#### Unparalleled customer service

For nearly 50 years, customers have relied on Creative's personalized customer service. By building
strong relationships and catering to your individual requirements, Creative's customer service will
guide you through all of your coatings needs.

#### No minimums

Our no minimum order policy helps our customers not only complete even the most unique jobs with
ease, it minimizes waste from ordering unnecessary excess material. We understand that sometimes you
just need a little more to finish a job, we pride ourselves in finding solutions for jobs of all
sizes.

#### Centrally located

Located less than 20 minutes outside of Detroit, MI, our warehouse can ship to any spot in the
contiguous United States in 2-3 days transit time via traditional ground service, eliminating the
needs for pricey expediting options.

#### ISO Certified

We are proud to announce that the Quality Management System at Creative Coatings Co. Inc. has been
evaluated by Eagle Registrations Inc. and meets the AS 9100D standard, which includes ISO 9001:2015.

Creative Coatings Acquisition and Introduction:

We are back!

For the past 3 months, the four of us ([Chris Stevenson][43], [Bobby Malaczewski][44], Joseph Creek,
and [Jesse Creek][45]) have been working together towards purchasing Creative Coatings, and that
goal has finally become a reality. As of September 1st, we have acquired the [Creative Coatings
Co.][46]

What this means is that the four of us, along with Ron Plonkey, Anthony Citraro, and Mike Marsee,
will make up the new Creative Coatings Company. Rich Plonkey will be staying on temporarily to help
ease the transition. All of our products will continue to ship from the Michigan facility, giving us
a strong, centrally located distribution center for our expanding product offerings. Creative
Coatings Company will now be official distributors for the following product lines:

-AkzoNobel Aerospace Coatings- full tier 1 distributor
-Hentzen Coatings- full distributor
-NCP Coatings- full distributor

In addition to the above, Creative Coatings will now begin to fully stock a wide variety of coatings
and products from the following companies:

-PPG Aerospace- fully stocking both

### ENSURING QUALITY

At Fortunecoat Industries Pvt. Ltd., quality is embedded at every stage of manufacturing. We follow
standardized processes focused on continual improvement. All raw materials are inspected as per
defined specifications. No process is completed without rigorous quality control testing, also
critical manufacturing parameters, starting from magnetic separator, mixing, extrusion, pulverising,
and Blending are closely monitored to maintain uniform quality. A controlled particle size
distribution ensures higher transfer efficiency, uniform film thickness, smooth surface finish, and
reduced powder wastage. Every batch undergoes online testing for colour and gloss consistency, film
thickness (DFT), adhesion, impact resistance, curing performance, and surface uniformity at specific
frequency to ensure homogeneity throughout the batch.

Complete batch traceability and regular audits further strengthen consistent quality, performance
reliability, and sustainability standards. This industry-focused approach ensures consistent
delivery of high-quality powder coatings to our customers.

[Lightbulb icon] Coating Design & Technical Support

Coating Design & Technical Support

With over 40 years of experience in aerospace and industrial coatings, Indestructible Paint Ltd provides expert coating design and technical problem-solving for demanding engineering applications.

Working closely with customers, we develop specialist coating solutions that meet precise technical requirements, including advanced Dry Film Lubricants and Intumescent Paint systems for performance-critical environments.

[Car icon] In-Depth Experience

In-Depth Experience

Our customers range from leading companies in the aero engine and aerospace sectors to organisations across automotive, defence and general industrial markets.

With decades of experience developing advanced aerospace coatings, we create solutions that meet the precise technical requirements and exacting performance standards demanded by our clients.

[Science Icon] Delivering Solutions

Delivering Solutions

Our research and development team continuously develops new coating technologies to meet evolving industry requirements and customer challenges.

Recent innovations include water-based coatings, low-VOC systems and chrome-free coating technologies, designed to deliver high performance while supporting modern environmental and regulatory standards.

[Plane Icon] Markets Served

Markets Served

Our specialist coatings are used across a wide range of industries and high-performance applications.

Key sectors include aerospace, aero engines and airframes, high-temperature and thermal barrier applications, gas turbines & power generation, defence engineering, automotive, rail and advanced industrial manufacturing.

[Globe Icon] International Distribution

International Distribution

From our UK manufacturing facilities, we supply customers in over 80 countries worldwide.

Our growing global distributor network ensures that our specialist coating technologies are available to customers across international aerospace and industrial markets.

[Basket Icon] Product Sourcing

Product Sourcing

# Your system supplier for industrial coatings

We provide comprehensive **industrial coatings and varnish systems** for all surfaces and the
highest standards of the most demanding industries. Our assortment includes** liquid
coatings** and **powder coatings**, **e-coats**,** gelcoats**, as well as** industrial sealants and
adhesives**.

Take, for instance, the application process for a construction vehicle: Multiple coating systems are
seamlessly utilized across various surfaces and components during horizontal coating. Ensuring a
flawless match in colour, surface finish, gloss level, and aging properties is fundamental for
manufacturers.

## Find the perfect colorant solution specifically tailored for your product

Using the right additives is the key to ensure stability and performance for any colorant solution,
and it takes experience and expertise to do it right. At Namei Material Technology, we specialize in
crafting the perfect colorant solution tailored specifically for your product needs. Over the last
15 years, we’ve gathered a team of professors and engineers in our technical team and created
numerous patents and innovative solutions to guarantee optimal performance for our color solution.
we are uniquely equipped to create customized formulas or provide high-quality standard colorant
solutions to solve any of your unique color challenges. Whether you have any challenges in color
strength, color stability, VOC levels and more, our solutions will meet your precise needs,
providing consistent, high-quality results you can rely on.

## Cut costs by taking advantage of the world's biggest pigment-origin

Pigments play a crucial role in any colorant solution and significantly impact its cost. At Namei
Material Technology, we leverage our strategic location in China, the world’s largest pigment
origin, to secure both cost and quality advantages. This unique positioning allows us to source
premium pigments at lower costs, ensuring our customers benefit from high-quality, stable colorants
without the premium price tag. By partnering with Namei, you not only achieve superior color
performance but also enjoy significant cost savings, making your products more competitive in the
market.

## Who we are

POR-15^{®} high-performance coatings revolutionized rust protection in 1978 with our unrivaled
moisture cure rust preventive undercoating technology. Our state-of-the-art paint systems form an
impenetrable barrier that protects surfaces from water, chemicals, salt, U.V. rays, corrosive
contaminants, impacts, and everyday wear and tear. Designed for application directly on rusted or
seasoned metal surfaces and concrete; POR-15^{®} products are applied to vehicles, heavy-duty
equipment, and structures around the world. Our products are used on antique cars in museums, DIY
classic cars, professional award-winning automotive restorations, body shops, government trucks, and
heavy-duty farm equipment. We are the gold standard in rust prevention, and we will continue
focusing on the quality and performance of our POR-15^{®} branded products and elevating them to a
new level.

## Thin Film. Thick Film. Real Insulation Science Performance!

**SPI Coatings** is the only insulation-coating manufacturer that developed both **thin-film and
thick-film ceramic systems**, each engineered for a completely different heat-control function.

Thin films are designed to **block radiative** heat at the surface.

Thick films are designed to **hold and control conducted heat** on hot substrates.

They are not interchangeable.

No matter what a manufacturer claims, a thick coating cannot block radiative heat the way a properly
engineered thin ceramic film can. The physics doesn’t allow it.

Most insulation-coating suppliers only offer an average-performing thick film and market it as a
universal solution. Industry is now discovering the limitation.

Between 1989 and 1995, SPI Coatings worked directly with [NASA][146] in a six-year research program
led by the company’s founder, focusing on ceramic compound behaviour.

decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

# UV Index App

Welcome! Select an option to begin:

Use my location
Enter a location





[sunburn]

## Don't get burned

UV Index App is here to shed light on sun exposure. Should you wear sunscreen today? How long should
you stay outside? How does skin color affect safe sun exposure? What if it's cloudy? Find out here.



## It's a matter of time

How long does it take to get a sunburn? How much exposure is necessary for adequate Vitamin D
intake? What if I have lighter skin? What if I use sunscreen? We'll crunch those numbers for you
based on the current weather and sun position.

[hourglass]


[calendar and graph]

## Forecast & History

Envision your sun protection plan with a 7-day forecast or relive the sunshine by checking out the
3-day history of UV Index data.




## Customized for You

The sun affects us all differently. We help interpret the data to fit your specific needs:


[skin colors]

### Skin Color

It is widely known that people with lighter skin tend to be more susceptible to sunburns while
people with darker skin take longer to react to ultraviolet radiation. We break down exposure time
estimates by each skin color on the [Fitzpatrick Scale][7] to estimate sunburn and Vitamin D times.

[surface reflection]

### Surface Reflection

Whether you’re in the city or at the summit, the backyard or the beach, the surfaces around you can
reflect up to 80% of UV radiation. Choose from different surfaces such as asphalt, sand, soil, snow
and more.

[globe]

### Any Location

UV radiation varies based on numerous factors including latitude, time of year, altitude, ozone
level and cloud cover. Using a set of globally available resources, we crunch the numbers for your
location and time of day so you don’t have to.

[devices]

### Any Device

Uvindex.app is a device-agnostic platform and is designed to be accessible from desktop computers,
tablets, and mobile devices. Oh, and it's also free to use.

[sunburn]

## The Meaning of UV Index

The [UV Index][8] (or ultraviolet index) was developed to help people protect themselves from
ultraviolet radiation from the sun. While exposure to sunlight has health benefits in moderation, it
poses serious health risks including sunburns, skin aging, cancer, immunosuppression, DNA damage and
eye damage when excessive. The UV Index at any given time is presented as a number ranging from 0 to
14, representing values on a linear scale. A UV Index value of 0 means that there is no UV
radiation, and a UV Index of 10 is intended to represent the UV radiation of a clear summer day at
around noon.

# High Performance
# UV Cured Coatings

PCI Labs is a supplier of high-performance UV Cured Coatings for thermoplastic materials. Our
products protect, preserve, enhance the appearance, and improve the function, performance and
durability of thermoplastic products in high technology markets.

[Explore Products][14] [Contact Us][15]

## About PCI Labs UV Cured Coatings

PCI Labs' UV-curable, primer free coatings provide superior scratch, abrasion and chemical
resistance as well as excellent anti-fog, anti-static, anti-glare and anti-weathering properties to
enhance the chemical, physical, optical and environmental performance of thermoplastics.

PCI Labs' UV-curable coatings protect, preserve, enhance the functionality, performance and improve
the aesthetic appeal of your injection molded, cast or extruded thermoplastic parts or sheet
materials.

## It's All About Chemistry

PCI Labs' UV Cured Coatings are thin films applied to a surface to protect the substrate from its
environment. Our specialized chemistry delivers measurable performance benefits across every
application.
* Very fast cure times
* Low heat requirements
* Thin dry film thickness
* High abrasion and chemical resistance
* Adaptable to high and low volume production
* Cost effective & value driven
* High quality, high yields
* Excellent environmental performance

## ABOUT WORTHEN

Worthen Industries manufactures specialty adhesives, coatings, coated flexible substrates, and
thermoplastic extrusion for diversified markets. We specialize in sustainable innovation by applying
technology, responsible manufacturing, and a customer-first approach to every challenge. The result
is a solution ensuring that our customer's processes, product quality and efficiency are optimized.
As a family owned and operated company that has been around since 1866, we are extremely proud of
our history and our vision to develop industry-leading solutions that contribute to a sustainable
future. We are committed to this mission by collaborating with our partners, going above and beyond
in customer support, and ensuring employee health safety because we believe that the future is worth
doing right.

## More than 150 years of experience in the coatings industry



## **Refinish and Aftermarket**

Experience the difference with our industry-leading refinish products ranging from surface
preparation to undercoats, basecoats, clearcoats, color-matching technologies and accessories. As
the leader in the refinish market we are supporting body shops around the world and reshaping the
industry through innovation for a better way of doing business.

[Learn about our Refinish products][6]



## **Mobility**

We are leading the way in light vehicle and commercial vehicle coatings for original equipment
manufacturers through advanced technologies that protect vehicle exteriors and interiors, insulate
electric motors, increase productivity in the paint shop, and add beauty and color. Our Mobility
solutions comprise Axalta's best-in-class basecoats and clearcoats for color and beautification
along with primers, electrocoats and powder applications for surface protection.

[Learn about our Mobility coatings][7]



## **Industrial**

Our performance coatings are ideal for a wide variety of industrial applications. Our liquid,
electrocoat and powder coating solutions serve an array of industrial segments including those
manufacturing industrial and electrical system components, oil and gas pipelines, wood applications,
agricultural, construction and earth moving equipment, rail cars, structural steel, and sports
equipment.

## More than 150 years of experience in the coatings industry



## **Refinish and Aftermarket**

Experience the difference with our industry-leading refinish products ranging from surface
preparation to undercoats, basecoats, clearcoats, color-matching technologies and accessories. As
the leader in the refinish market we are supporting body shops around the world and reshaping the
industry through innovation for a better way of doing business.

[Learn about our Refinish products][6]



## **Mobility**

We are leading the way in light vehicle and commercial vehicle coatings for original equipment
manufacturers through advanced technologies that protect vehicle exteriors and interiors, insulate
electric motors, increase productivity in the paint shop, and add beauty and color. Our Mobility
solutions comprise Axalta's best-in-class basecoats and clearcoats for color and beautification
along with primers, electrocoats and powder applications for surface protection.

[Learn about our Mobility coatings][7]



## **Industrial**

Our performance coatings are ideal for a wide variety of industrial applications. Our liquid,
electrocoat and powder coating solutions serve an array of industrial segments including those
manufacturing industrial and electrical system components, oil and gas pipelines, wood applications,
agricultural, construction and earth moving equipment, rail cars, structural steel, and sports
equipment.

## Aerospace

### Engineered for Performance

Delivering new technologies for transparencies, coatings, sealants, packaging, and chemical
management for the aviation industries.

Learn More

## Automotive OEM

### Forefront of Innovation

Combining PPG’s expertise in coatings and technologies to aid automakers around the world in
enhancing the image and identity of their vehicle brands.

Learn More

## Automotive Refinish

### Breakthrough Performance

When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, PPG's refinish
business owns a track record of success no other company can match.

Learn More

## Industrial Coatings

### Tomorrow Realized

Leading manufacturers trust PPG’s global color stylists, chemists and technical application experts
to provide the innovative coatings that enhance the products we use every day.

Learn More

## Packaging Coatings

### Leading the Pack

For decades, PPG’s research and development experts have created coatings that have made products
better across nearly every industry, from food and beverage, to cosmetics and personal care, to
paints and chemicals. 

Learn More

## Protective & Marine Coatings

### Unrivaled Performance

Developing products that protect customers’ assets in some of the world’s most demanding conditions
and environments, including civil infrastructure, offshore, petrochemical, power, marine new-build,
marine dry dock and marine sea stock.

Learn More

## Traffic Solutions

### Performance that protects

The broad, global portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint,
thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road
workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

Learn More

Learn More

A high-performance material used for product labels, ID cards and more.

Learn More

## Filtration Technologies


An innovative new technology that make the sustainable recovery of industrial process water and
wastewater more efficient and economical.

production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in

## PREFERRED SUPPLIER

Boero YachtCoatings are the preferred choice, as we ensure our customers have the best custom
coating solutions, from the full and versatile range of product, superior performance for any type
of substrate, application and conditions, all supported by the Boero technical team and product
warranty

### Boero LifeCycle

An integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and services to meet the most
complex requirements.

We promote the Boero LifeCycle with a dedicated team, focused on the best maintenance and aftersales
service to superyacht: shipyards, captains and management, offering global support, product
information and service. We support the Boero LifeCycle with our technical services, offering
practical coatings advice, specification, inspection and various levels of training.

[Discover Boero LifeCycle][41]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Boero Technical Service

Boero YachtCoatings actively engages in customer service by taking our involvement with our
customers past the point of the actual sale of our products into the shipyard, dry dock,
construction site and workshops to assist our customers obtain the required coating finish and to
conform to the project coating specification.
Boero YachtCoatings achieves this in field service by employing a dedicated group of qualified
staff, known as Boero Coating Advisors. Boero Coating Advisors are located in most of the markets
where Boero YachtCoatings is promoting and selling products, being part of the local technical
service team and report to the local Technical Service Manager.

[Discover Techical Services][42]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Full range of products

Boero YachtCoatings has a comprehensive range of products and coating solutions that cover all
requirements for both yacht and superyacht painting. Coatings that cover above and below waterline,
exterior and interior systems and all types of tanks and specialist areas.
With a variety of product options in each product group: Anti-fouling, Fillers, Primers, Tank
coatings and Topcoats – Boero YachtCoatings has a coating solution to suit all needs, offering
performance in the most demanding of environments.
Boero YachtCoatings offer complete coating systems to suit a variety of uses, application,
environmental conditions and expected finish.

[Discover Products][43]

# **Welcome to Clean Coats**

### About Us

**[Clean Coats Company Image]CLEAN COATS has been a leader in the field of Specialty Coatings in
India for over 2 decades. We provide state-of-the-art coatings for a wide range of applications.
including Wall & Floor Coatings, Tank, structural, pipeline,concrete coatings. Our coatings are
backed by extensive research and development, and are trusted by customers across the country.
**

With an in-house team of experienced professionals, we execute coating projects of all sizes with
complete responsibility for selected high-value projects in the corporate sector.

**Reliable performance. Customized Solutions. Large Project Capabilities. Wide Range**

Clean Coats has a very strong presence in Irrigation, Water Supply, Power, Oil-Gas & Refinery,
Chemical, Pharma, Food, Automobile & many other such industries. We also export to over 27 countries
and have satisfied customers all over the world.

The Organization has qualified professionals with significant experience in various areas such as
Research & Development, Technical Support, Quality Control, Specification design and Site Execution.

CLEAN COATS has a consistent and well established track record of servicing its Clients. It has an
in-house application team as well in order to provide Clients with a comprehensive and
end-to-end-service package.

**The Company is accredited with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications.**

## Our Product Offerings

[

#### FOOD GRADE PIPE INTERNAL COATING

][15]

CLEAN TECH PW -food grade epoxy coating with over 25 lac m2 of successful performance; certified by
CFTRI,WRAS & conforming to AWWA C210 & IS16676 for potable water services

[

#### PIPE INTERNAL
#### COATING

][16]

We offer our glass flake, phenolic epoxy coatings to combat pipe internal corrosion against a
variety of service media like effluent water, sea water, RO Water, DM Water etc., Chemicals &
hydrocarbbons like ATF, natural gas etc..

[

#### SOLAR PANEL STRUCTURE COATING

][17]

Our R&D customized a corrosion protection solution for application on solar trackers & structures in
C5M environment like the photo of a large project at Morrocco done under French consultant

[

#### SWEATING & CRYOGENIC LINE PROTECTION

][18]
Our uniquely formulated product CHEMITECH UW enables coating of cryogenic & ice encrusted pipelines
in insitu running condition like this at a fertilizer major at Mumbai.

[

#### PIPE EXTERNAL
#### COATING

][19]

We offer multiple solutions like High solids polyurethane, High solids epoxy conforming to DIN
10289, traditional corrosion resistant coating systems. The photo is from a sea water based gas
based power plant in Gujarat

[

#### MOUNDED STORAGE VESSELS COATINGS

][20]

Our solvent free polyurethane coating CLEAN TECH HPEC 1001(J) has been successfully performing in a
number of mounded bullets of almost all oil majors like BPCL,IOCL etc. Above Job done for LPG
terminal at Nagpur.

[

#### CLEAN ROOM WALL COATING

][21]
We offer unmatched clean room wall & floor coatings for pharma industries & operation theatres in
hospitals. The photo is the image of the job done at Breach Candy Hospital Mumbai.

[

#### METAL REPAIR
#### PRODUCTS

][22]
The power of ceramic reinforced epoxies has been harnessed in our Metal Repair Products to enable
faster restoration of worn out metals & improve fluid flow conditions

[

#### ANTI - CARBONATION
#### COATING

][23]
our Anti Carbonation Coating successfully protect number of structures like the Shivaji Memorial in
Mumbai.


[

#### HEAT RESISTANT
#### COATING

][24]
Heat resistant coatings that can resist upto 600 deg centigrade. Photo is of chimney coating from a
coastal gas based power plant at Maharashtra


[

#### BI-POLAR CONCRETE ADMIXTURE

][25]
Our CONPROOF IA is a powerful bi polar Concrete penetrating corrosion inhibiting admixture that is
approved by EIL & has been used in a number of oil & gas projects across the country.

[

#### EPOXY & PU FLOORING

][26]
Our pioneering product line consisting of high performing Epoxy & PU flooring systems for over 20
years for food & pharma, auto & a variety of other industries & warehouses. The range also has car
park coatings.

Chemical, Pharma, Food, Automobile & many other such industries. We also export to over 27 countries
and have satisfied customers all over the world.

Research & Development, Technical Support, Quality Control, Specification design and Site Execution.

in-house application team as well in order to provide Clients with a comprehensive and
end-to-end-service package.

### ENSURING QUALITY

At Fortunecoat Industries Pvt. Ltd., quality is embedded at every stage of manufacturing. We follow
standardized processes focused on continual improvement. All raw materials are inspected as per
defined specifications. No process is completed without rigorous quality control testing, also
critical manufacturing parameters, starting from magnetic separator, mixing, extrusion, pulverising,
and Blending are closely monitored to maintain uniform quality. A controlled particle size
distribution ensures higher transfer efficiency, uniform film thickness, smooth surface finish, and
reduced powder wastage. Every batch undergoes online testing for colour and gloss consistency, film
thickness (DFT), adhesion, impact resistance, curing performance, and surface uniformity at specific
frequency to ensure homogeneity throughout the batch.

Complete batch traceability and regular audits further strengthen consistent quality, performance
reliability, and sustainability standards. This industry-focused approach ensures consistent
delivery of high-quality powder coatings to our customers.

# Industrial Coatings

Industrial CoatingsIncon_Webteam2026-02-09T09:25:17+01:00

# Your system supplier for industrial coatings

We provide comprehensive **industrial coatings and varnish systems** for all surfaces and the
highest standards of the most demanding industries. Our assortment includes** liquid
coatings** and **powder coatings**, **e-coats**,** gelcoats**, as well as** industrial sealants and
adhesives**.

Take, for instance, the application process for a construction vehicle: Multiple coating systems are
seamlessly utilized across various surfaces and components during horizontal coating. Ensuring a
flawless match in colour, surface finish, gloss level, and aging properties is fundamental for
manufacturers.

[Graphic showing a yellow excavator]

## System coatings and industrial markets at a glance

KAPCI Coatings was established in 1985 as a private company only devoted for the production of car
refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

# Say Goodbye To All Your Color Related Challenges With This Industry Leading Colorant Solution
# Provider

At Namei Material Technology, we’re the trusted partner of some of the biggest industrial brands in
the world, supplying over 6000 tons of colorant every year. Leverage our expertise for a better and
more affordable colorant solution for your business by talking to our technical experts today.

1000+ Customers

## Find the perfect colorant solution specifically tailored for your product

Using the right additives is the key to ensure stability and performance for any colorant solution,
and it takes experience and expertise to do it right. At Namei Material Technology, we specialize in
crafting the perfect colorant solution tailored specifically for your product needs. Over the last
15 years, we’ve gathered a team of professors and engineers in our technical team and created
numerous patents and innovative solutions to guarantee optimal performance for our color solution.
we are uniquely equipped to create customized formulas or provide high-quality standard colorant
solutions to solve any of your unique color challenges. Whether you have any challenges in color
strength, color stability, VOC levels and more, our solutions will meet your precise needs,
providing consistent, high-quality results you can rely on.

## Cut costs by taking advantage of the world's biggest pigment-origin

Pigments play a crucial role in any colorant solution and significantly impact its cost. At Namei
Material Technology, we leverage our strategic location in China, the world’s largest pigment
origin, to secure both cost and quality advantages. This unique positioning allows us to source
premium pigments at lower costs, ensuring our customers benefit from high-quality, stable colorants
without the premium price tag. By partnering with Namei, you not only achieve superior color
performance but also enjoy significant cost savings, making your products more competitive in the
market.

# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.
About us
We make products better with our integrated offering of advanced materials, coating equipment and
services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.

Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

Oerlikon makes metals ready for the deep sea: coatings and materials protect drill bits, valves,
pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

Taking off safely and efficiently

From turbines to landing gear, Oerlikon technologies help make aircraft safer, more efficient and
more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]
3
High performance for high performance

Semiconductors power everything from smartphones to cars and AI data centers. Oerlikon supports the
industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]

Sustainable, durable and safe mobility

Oerlikon supports the automotive industry with solutions that make mobility safer and more

manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

## Coatings Resource Center

## [More Videos and Resources > ][145]

## Thin Film. Thick Film. Real Insulation Science Performance!

**SPI Coatings** is the only insulation-coating manufacturer that developed both **thin-film and
thick-film ceramic systems**, each engineered for a completely different heat-control function.

Thin films are designed to **block radiative** heat at the surface.

Thick films are designed to **hold and control conducted heat** on hot substrates.

They are not interchangeable.

No matter what a manufacturer claims, a thick coating cannot block radiative heat the way a properly
engineered thin ceramic film can. The physics doesn’t allow it.

Most insulation-coating suppliers only offer an average-performing thick film and market it as a
universal solution. Industry is now discovering the limitation.

Between 1989 and 1995, SPI Coatings worked directly with [NASA][146] in a six-year research program
led by the company’s founder, focusing on ceramic compound behaviour.

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

# UV Index App

Welcome! Select an option to begin:

Use my location
Enter a location





[sunburn]

## Don't get burned

UV Index App is here to shed light on sun exposure. Should you wear sunscreen today? How long should
you stay outside? How does skin color affect safe sun exposure? What if it's cloudy? Find out here.



## It's a matter of time

How long does it take to get a sunburn? How much exposure is necessary for adequate Vitamin D
intake? What if I have lighter skin? What if I use sunscreen? We'll crunch those numbers for you
based on the current weather and sun position.

[hourglass]


[calendar and graph]

## Forecast & History

Envision your sun protection plan with a 7-day forecast or relive the sunshine by checking out the
3-day history of UV Index data.




## Customized for You

The sun affects us all differently. We help interpret the data to fit your specific needs:


[skin colors]

### Skin Color

It is widely known that people with lighter skin tend to be more susceptible to sunburns while
people with darker skin take longer to react to ultraviolet radiation. We break down exposure time
estimates by each skin color on the [Fitzpatrick Scale][7] to estimate sunburn and Vitamin D times.

[surface reflection]

### Surface Reflection

Whether you’re in the city or at the summit, the backyard or the beach, the surfaces around you can
reflect up to 80% of UV radiation. Choose from different surfaces such as asphalt, sand, soil, snow
and more.

[globe]

### Any Location

UV radiation varies based on numerous factors including latitude, time of year, altitude, ozone
level and cloud cover. Using a set of globally available resources, we crunch the numbers for your
location and time of day so you don’t have to.

[devices]

### Any Device

Uvindex.app is a device-agnostic platform and is designed to be accessible from desktop computers,
tablets, and mobile devices. Oh, and it's also free to use.

[sunburn]

## The Meaning of UV Index

The [UV Index][8] (or ultraviolet index) was developed to help people protect themselves from
ultraviolet radiation from the sun. While exposure to sunlight has health benefits in moderation, it
poses serious health risks including sunburns, skin aging, cancer, immunosuppression, DNA damage and
eye damage when excessive. The UV Index at any given time is presented as a number ranging from 0 to
14, representing values on a linear scale. A UV Index value of 0 means that there is no UV
radiation, and a UV Index of 10 is intended to represent the UV radiation of a clear summer day at
around noon.

The [UV Index][8] (or ultraviolet index) was developed to help people protect themselves from
ultraviolet radiation from the sun. While exposure to sunlight has health benefits in moderation, it
poses serious health risks including sunburns, skin aging, cancer, immunosuppression, DNA damage and
eye damage when excessive. The UV Index at any given time is presented as a number ranging from 0 to
14, representing values on a linear scale. A UV Index value of 0 means that there is no UV
radiation, and a UV Index of 10 is intended to represent the UV radiation of a clear summer day at
around noon.

PCI Labs is a supplier of high-performance UV Cured Coatings for thermoplastic materials. Our
products protect, preserve, enhance the appearance, and improve the function, performance and

## About PCI Labs UV Cured Coatings

PCI Labs' UV-curable, primer free coatings provide superior scratch, abrasion and chemical
resistance as well as excellent anti-fog, anti-static, anti-glare and anti-weathering properties to
enhance the chemical, physical, optical and environmental performance of thermoplastics.

PCI Labs' UV-curable coatings protect, preserve, enhance the functionality, performance and improve
the aesthetic appeal of your injection molded, cast or extruded thermoplastic parts or sheet
materials.
